shang-route-1.label: Shang-Yang
shang-route-1.title: Shang-Yang • embassy and living forge
shang-route-1.intro: Your long-term headquarters; on the trade route the capital is deliberately pushed to tier five. These are the archive’s effective Route I capital priorities, not a verified current build order: settlement tiers, slot totals, construction costs and recruitment access in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview and the province’s actual slots before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Secure the city and province
steps.note: Repair useful buildings, establish Control and protect the approach before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Growth + reliable income
steps.note: Build the appropriate Tea Parlour or conscription branch, and an ordinary income chain. Spread complementary Harmony choices across the province.

steps.title: House of Secrets
steps.note: Recruit and support Alchemists through the distinctive landmark.

steps.title: One coherent arsenal
steps.note: Jade infantry/crossbows plus the gunners chain. Keep basic recruitment in a suitable minor settlement if capital slots are crowded.

steps.title: Advance the capital for actual unlocks
steps.note: Route I prioritises tier five; other routes go higher when the next troops or economics justify the cost.

steps.title: Great Embassy / Celestial upgrades
steps.note: Build the Embassy for Route I. For another route, it is optional while missing field troops or recovery infrastructure take priority.

details: Two different landmarks
House of Secrets at tier three is not the Great Embassy at tier five. Having excellent Alchemists does not complete the Embassy victory checkbox.
Suggested mature slot priorities

Settlement main building + House of Secrets + Great Embassy when needed + income + advanced recruitment suited to the army. Fill only the slots your settlement actually offers; distribute growth/basic recruitment elsewhere once developed. Capital slots are scarce: specialist infantry, artillery and magic chains compete with landmarks, so keep ordinary income, resources, growth and basic recruitment in suitable other towns.
Queue savings while Zhao is present
Strange Alchemy reduces construction costs in his local province. Queue an already-planned major project during a normal visit; do not drag the army across the continent just for the discount.
Avoid an income assumption

House of Secrets has conflicting published income figures — see the shared fundamentals note for the two archive values. Its recruitment value is reliable enough for the plan; use the actual value in your own building preview rather than budgeting either published number.
Lions and Tigers are real recruitment projects

For the alchemical company, add the tier-three Celestial Tower for paired lions; it also provides Astromancer recruitment and the lion families. For the trading/frontier Tiger contingent, develop the Tiger chain — Tiger Warrior Den → Clawspeaker Shrine → Iron Claw Barracks, tier four in ordinary Cathay; do not copy the White Tigress’s faction-specific costs. Neither chain belongs in every income town.

shang-route-2.label: Shang-Yang
shang-route-2.title: Shang-Yang • embassy and living forge
shang-route-2.intro: Your long-term headquarters; the alchemical expedition develops the House of Secrets and one high-tier assembly hub without treating the Great Embassy as a priority. These are the archive’s effective Route II capital priorities, not a verified current build order: settlement tiers, slot totals, construction costs and recruitment access in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview and the province’s actual slots before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Secure the city and province
steps.note: Repair useful buildings, establish Control and protect the approach before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Growth + reliable income
steps.note: Build the appropriate Tea Parlour or conscription branch, and an ordinary income chain. Spread complementary Harmony choices across the province.

steps.title: House of Secrets
steps.note: Recruit and support Alchemists through the distinctive landmark.

steps.title: One coherent arsenal
steps.note: Jade infantry/crossbows plus the gunners chain. Keep basic recruitment in a suitable minor settlement if capital slots are crowded.

steps.title: Celestial Tower for the paired guardians
steps.note: Recruit the lions which define the Alchemical Survey; advance the capital only for the next real recruitment or income requirement.

steps.title: Fire Rain / Celestial assembly hub
steps.note: Prioritise the expedition’s late troops and a safe refit. The Great Embassy is optional in this route, not a reason to postpone the expedition.

shang-route-3.label: Shang-Yang
shang-route-3.title: Shang-Yang • embassy and living forge
shang-route-3.intro: Your long-term headquarters; before the western wars it must supply one coherent arsenal and a defensible economic base. These are the archive’s effective Route III capital priorities, not a verified current build order: settlement tiers, slot totals, construction costs and recruitment access in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview and the province’s actual slots before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Secure the city and province
steps.note: Repair useful buildings, establish Control and protect the approach before starting several expensive projects.

steps.title: Growth + reliable income
steps.note: Build the appropriate Tea Parlour or conscription branch, and an ordinary income chain. Spread complementary Harmony choices across the province.

steps.title: House of Secrets
steps.note: Recruit and support Alchemists through the distinctive landmark.

steps.title: One coherent arsenal
steps.note: Jade infantry/crossbows plus the gunners chain. Keep basic recruitment in a suitable minor settlement if capital slots are crowded.

steps.title: Tier-four line and frontier tools
steps.note: Celestial Barracks, the appropriate gun chain and optional Tiger/Longma recruitment support the westward armies.

steps.title: Fund the western regional hub
steps.note: Do not keep all new money in Shang-Yang while the frontier lacks replacements. Tier five is useful when the actual economy supports it; the Embassy is optional.

muster.label: Muster hub
muster.title: Regional muster • replacements near the war
muster.intro: A second recruitment province makes sense when travel is the bottleneck, not simply because another province was captured. These are the archive’s muster-chain priorities, not a verified current build order: tiers, costs, capacity and recruitment access in the installed build are unverified. Read the live building and recruitment/capacity tooltips before duplicating an arsenal.

steps.title: Secure a defensible capital
steps.note: Choose a place your supporting army can reach. A recruitment hub lost next turn is not infrastructure.

steps.title: Training Camp → Dormitory
steps.note: Develop basic Jade troops and crossbows. Keep using earlier units as the chain grows.

steps.title: Jade Barracks + recovery/income
steps.note: At tier three, Jade Barracks adds halberds, shielded crossbows and Gate Master access/capacity. Add only the heroes that the local armies need.

steps.title: Nan-Gau Forge → Powder Magazine
steps.note: Tier-three Powder Magazine provides Cannons, Crane Gunners and the War Drum. Tier-four Fire Rain Silo adds Rockets. Build this chain before writing these units into a new local army.

steps.title: Fire Rain / Celestial recruitment as needed
steps.note: Build capital-level chains only for units you will recruit in that theatre.

steps.title: Stop duplicating specialist buildings
steps.note: A forward hub usually needs replacement infantry, shooters and artillery—not a second copy of every landmark and flying-beast chain.

details: Who needs it first?
Route III normally develops a western field hub earlier. Route II uses one dependable staging hub before the long march. Route I can delay another full arsenal while income provinces develop.
Recruit before departure
Upgrade the flagship in a safe location, replenish, then move. Do not leave the front immobilised while half the army waits through global recruitment.
Hero slots

Add capacity only when you have a real job for another hero. Read the actual recruitment/capacity tooltip rather than assuming one hero appears per province. Until a hero can be recruited, use an extra useful troop; the archive applies that substitution to the Home Guard’s intentional 12-slot size and basic early forces.
Elite line and shooters
Celestial Barracks at tier four supplies Dragon Guard; its tier-five Armoury upgrade supplies the elite crossbows. Keep Jade veterans until replacements are available and affordable.
Flying cavalry
Longma Paddocks moved to tier four in the 8.0 rework. A Longma unit remains optional; the grounded Mountain Column variant avoids an aerial-micro dependency.

income.label: Income town
income.title: Safe income town • fund the realm
income.intro: An ordinary town should earn money and support its province without becoming an expensive miniature capital. The archive’s income-chain and Harmony-branch pattern is a priority order, not a verified current build order: exact effects, tiers and slot requirements in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview before spending an economic slot.

steps.title: Repair + settlement upgrade
steps.note: Prioritise a useful income base and necessary slots.

steps.title: Wares Market OR Spice Market
steps.note: Choose the economic branch that complements the province’s planned Harmony.

steps.title: Tea Parlour OR conscription
steps.note: Support growth until the province reaches useful tiers; avoid building both exclusive versions in one town.

steps.title: Upgrade the chosen income chain
steps.note: Merchant Caravans / Trade Exchange are the Yang chain; the Yin chain supports its own industry/trade pattern.

steps.title: Resource or local support in the remaining slot
steps.note: Use a mine/port when present, Control if genuinely needed, or one missing basic-recruitment building.

steps.title: Replace spent growth selectively
steps.note: Once development is complete, convert growth space only when the replacement earns more or solves a current problem.

details: A simple provincial pattern
One town can run Yin growth plus Yang income; another can take the complementary branches. Include every existing military/resource building in the real province total before deciding.
Gross versus net
Income buildings help the gross-income objective. Removing an army saves upkeep, improving net income but not creating new gross revenue.
Defences are contextual
A safe interior town need not spend its best economic slot on a garrison chain. Reclassify it as a frontier town when a real hostile approach opens.

resource.label: Resources
resource.title: Resource settlement • develop the thing it owns
resource.intro: Useful in every route; particularly important when building a large recurring-income base. Resource buildings and their technologies are archive-driven priorities, not verified current values: actual income, trade production and development effects in the installed build are unverified. Read the live building effect and the province’s climate before planning around a mine.

steps.title: Check the resource and climate
steps.note: Read actual income, trade production and development penalties; map colour alone is not a business plan.

steps.title: Repair the resource chain
steps.note: Gold/gems are direct-income priorities; other materials can still support trade and useful local benefits.

steps.title: Add ordinary income
steps.note: Use the matching Yin/Yang branch for the province plan.

steps.title: Support growth and secure the town
steps.note: Grow a permanent holding. Add defence earlier when the mine is an obvious enemy target.

steps.title: Upgrade resource + main settlement
steps.note: Compare the actual income gain to cost. A small affordable upgrade can pay sooner than a grand capital project.

steps.title: Apply relevant resource technology
steps.note: Moon Wood’s different benefits depend on the resource/building present. Do not assume every town gets every listed effect.

details: Resource access is not caravan cargo
A new mine does not directly add its production to the VCO goods counter. Only observed completed caravan deliveries should be entered there.
Trade requires partners
A collection of resource buildings without useful agreements is not the same as a connected commercial network. Protect relations with practical customers.

depot.label: Recovery depot
depot.title: Forward depot • arrive, repair, move again
depot.intro: A limited-support settlement for campaigns beyond the developed heartland. These are the archive’s depot priorities, not a verified current build order: the installed build’s replenishment, recruitment and garrison behaviour are unverified. Check the army’s actual status and the settlement’s live options before assuming a forward stop supports the force.

steps.title: Take a defensible stop
steps.note: Choose where the next field army can actually recover and where you can hold the approach.

steps.title: Repair the main building
steps.note: An occupied ruin is not instantly a useful resupply base.

steps.title: Local income + growth/recovery support
steps.note: Spend modestly; check whether replenishment is actually available in the current stance and conditions.

steps.title: Basic replacements only
steps.note: Jade infantry and crossbows are often more useful here than another late-game monster chain.

steps.title: Garrison branch if the route stays exposed
steps.note: Pick Yang or Yin defence to suit province balance and the expected attacker.

steps.title: Leave a response plan
steps.note: Name the army which will answer a raid before Zhao continues west.

details: Do not overclaim healing
Growth buildings and a repair queue do not resurrect lost veteran units. Check the campaign replenishment tooltip; corruption, climate, stance and events can still obstruct recovery.
Ally access
Military access lets you travel, but does not automatically reproduce all your own recruitment and replenishment options. Inspect the army’s actual status before ending the turn.
Promote or stop
Promote a depot into a muster hub only when a longer war makes it necessary. Otherwise keep it cheap and functional.

frontier.label: Frontier
frontier.title: Frontier capital • hold the new border
frontier.intro: Especially important in the Mountains of Mourn, where distant provinces create more response time. The archive’s frontier guidance is a priority pattern, not a verified current build order: garrison chains, tiers and costs in the installed build are unverified. Decide who defends the place before founding a grand economy.

steps.title: Repair + stabilise Control
steps.note: Decide who will defend the place before laying foundations for a grand economy.

steps.title: Ramparts OR Archer Platforms
steps.note: Start the garrison family suited to the province’s balance and the type of pressure.

steps.title: Basic infantry and ranged replacement
steps.note: Use the regional hub nearby; do not automatically duplicate it in every town.

steps.title: Cannon Emplacements / stronger defences
steps.note: Upgrade where it changes the settlement’s survival odds, not just because a slot is empty.

steps.title: Income and provincial support
steps.note: A defended border still needs a budget. Preserve enough income to maintain its relief force.

steps.title: Reassess after the front moves
steps.note: A former frontier can become an income town. Demolish redundant defence only once the new border is genuinely safer.

details: Gate Master placement
Keep the hero with the army or settlement you intend to defend. A campaign assistance action must be applied and maintained according to its tooltip.
Different from the Great Bastion
An ordinary western frontier is not a Bastion Gate. Do not count on gate-only garrison bonuses or the Compass destroying every nearby enemy.
Full province checks
For Route III, inspect all settlement names in each required province. Owning its capital alone does not complete a province-control goal.

occupied.label: New province
occupied.title: New province • stabilise before specialising
occupied.intro: Use this category during a broad campaign, especially the four-province frontier route. The archive’s stabilisation pattern is not a verified current build order: climate effects, corruption, control and costs in the installed build are unverified. Read the province panel before committing buildings.

steps.title: Read climate, corruption and neighbours
steps.note: Identify whether this is a permanent holding, a supply link or merely an objective site.

steps.title: Repair useful existing buildings
steps.note: Demolish redundant military chains rather than automatically rebuild everything from scratch.

steps.title: Income + Control where required
steps.note: Restore recurring value first. Deal with disorder without creating an expensive idle army forever.

steps.title: Complete the province when worthwhile
steps.note: Route III needs four whole provinces. Elsewhere, avoid an unnecessary war merely to own the last town.

steps.title: Assign one capital role and town roles
steps.note: Choose the muster/frontier/income split. It need not match the last province you developed.

steps.title: Balance the province after major changes
steps.note: Inspect the total once the planned builds finish. A conquered building or upgrade can change the arithmetic.

details: Commandments

Jade Dragon supports growth, Iron Dragon development/research, Sea Dragon income and Storm Dragon corruption management. Choose the current local need; the names are not exclusive to the sibling you play.
High costs abroad
Low-suitability land can still be strategically necessary. Build the minimum support first, and do not assume Cathayan construction discounts erase every climate penalty.
Allied control
Treat direct control as the default for Route III unless the live VCO objective explicitly accepts an ally or vassal. Friendship and military access are not substitutes for that wording.

port.label: Trade port
port.title: Port city • income and sea logistics
port.intro: Build what the port actually contributes; Zhao’s victory routes do not automatically require conquering the coast. The archive’s port pattern is not a verified current build order: port income, naval effects and tiers in the installed build are unverified. Check the live building preview and the province plan before spending a coastal slot.

steps.title: Repair the port and secure the approach
steps.note: A sea route can add exposure as well as income.

steps.title: Add income and useful resources
steps.note: Use the actual provincial Harmony plan.

steps.title: Growth for a permanent commercial centre
steps.note: A port built as a temporary landing need not grow to tier five.

steps.title: Defence if seaborne raids threaten
steps.note: Give the garrison time to survive until the relief force arrives.

steps.title: Dragon Fleet Aegis when it pays
steps.note: The technology supports ports and is an approach to another caravan slot.

steps.title: Use special naval landmarks opportunistically
steps.note: Shi-Wu’s high-tier naval landmark helps a long-range operation, but is not mandatory for any of these three routes.

details: Ordinary travel, not teleportation
No route gives Zhao Elspeth’s Gardens or Ostankya’s forest travel. Plan sea lanes, landings and the return of ordinary field armies explicitly.
Ownership first
Do not attack a valuable ally merely to obtain an optional logistics landmark. The best route may be overland with friendly access.

raid.label: Temporary site
raid.title: Temporary objective • no rebuilding habit
raid.intro: For fixed sites taken during the alchemical expedition or land intended for a later handover. The archive’s temporary-site pattern keeps the objective’s live wording authoritative: the installed build’s raze/own credit and after-capture behaviour are unverified. Record the active VCO panel’s progress rather than assuming guide text grants credit.

steps.title: Check the exact objective verb
steps.note: Route II says raze or conquer, not merely sack.

steps.title: Record the live VCO credit
steps.note: Do not infer success from guide text or planning ticks alone; the active objective panel decides credit.

steps.title: Choose hold, ruin or future transfer
steps.note: Pick the option that preserves the objective and supports your next movement.

steps.title: Repair only what has a near-term purpose
steps.note: A useful replenishment stop or an income building can be enough.

steps.title: Defend the credit until confirmed
steps.note: Do not assume a raze/own condition stays complete after enemy recolonisation or a handover.

steps.title: Move the expedition forward
steps.note: Skip costly recruitment and growth plans in a settlement you do not intend to keep.

details: Mordheim can be politically awkward

It may be held by an Empire faction you want as a partner. Explore a legal settlement deal if available. A military alliance alone should not be treated as raze/own credit unless the actual objective confirms it.
No arbitrary occupation cap
Keep valuable land when doing so serves the campaign. The guide does not require either dumping every conquest or administering them all.
